account_name.description: Account name identifying the funding source. This may be `null`.

created.description: An RFC 3339 string representing when this funding source was added to the Lithic account. This may be `null`. UTC time zone.

last_four.description: The last 4 digits of the account (e.g. bank account, debit card) associated with this FundingAccount. This may be null.

nickname.description: The nickname given to the `FundingAccount` or `null` if it has no nickname.

state.description: State of funding source. Funding source states: * `ENABLED` - The funding account is available to use for card creation and transactions. * `PENDING` - The funding account is still being verified e.g. bank micro-deposits verification. * `DELETED` - The founding account has been deleted.

token.description: A globally unique identifier for this FundingAccount.

type.description: Types of funding source: * `DEPOSITORY_CHECKING` - Bank checking account. * `DEPOSITORY_SAVINGS` - Bank savings account.
